video: add of helper for display timings/videomode

This adds support for reading display timings from DT into a struct
bic_trace_step.code_snippet:
commit cc3f414cf2e404130584b63d373161ba6fd24bc2
Author: Steffen Trumtrar <s.trumtrar@pengutronix.de>
Date:   Thu Oct 4 15:32:52 2012 +0200

    video: add of helper for display timings/videomode
    
    This adds support for reading display timings from DT into a struct
    display_timings. The of_display_timing implementation supports multiple
    subnodes. All children are read into an array, that can be queried.
    
    If no native mode is specified, the first subnode will be used.
bic_trace_step.reason: In of_get_display_timings(), native_mode is obtained via of_parse_phandle() (or of_get_next_child) which increments the refcount. The error paths for num_timings==0 (line 'goto entryfail' after 'if (disp->num_timings == 0)') and for timings allocation failure (line 'goto entryfail' after 'if (!disp->timings)') jump to entryfail which only calls kfree(disp) and then dispfail: of_node_put(timings_np), but does not call of_node_put(native_mode). Only the timingfail label properly puts native_mode. This results in a refcount leak.
